description: This file defines a React component named EmailBackups responsible for managing email backup preferences in the application. It includes UI elements for selecting email backup frequency, toggling email notifications for failed backups, and handles loading/saving these settings using application-specific APIs.

methods.name: loadEmailFrequencySetting
methods.description: Asynchronously loads user's email backup frequency and mute setting from the application's settings storage.

methods.name: updateSetting
methods.description: Updates a given user setting via the application's settings API and handles potential errors.

methods.name: updateEmailFrequency
methods.description: Handles changing the email backup frequency and updates it in the application's settings.

methods.name: toggleMuteFailedBackupEmails
methods.description: Toggles the mute setting for failed backup emails and updates the application's settings.

methods.name: handleEmailFrequencyChange
methods.description: Handles changes in the email frequency dropdown selection.
